headword: {広告|こうこく}{代理店|だいりてん}

definitions.explanation: A company that plans and produces advertising and buys media space on behalf of client businesses. Composed of {広告|こうこく} (advertisement) + {代理店|だいりてん} (agency).

examples.japanese: {広告|こうこく}{代理店|だいりてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勤|つと}めている→勤める：00902_tsutomeru⟧。
examples.english: I work at an advertising agency.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{宣伝|せんでん}→宣伝：03307_senden⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{広告|こうこく}{代理店|だいりてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{任|まか}せた→任せる：02417_makaseru⟧。
examples.english: We left that promotion to an ad agency.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大手|おおて}→大手：12171_oote⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{広告|こうこく}{代理店|だいりてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦キャンペーン→キャンペーン：10809_kyanpeen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手|て}がけている→手がける：12753_tegakeru⟧。
examples.english: A major advertising agency is handling that company's new campaign.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{広告|こうこく}→広告：02747_koukoku⟧ (advertisement) + ⟦{代理店|だいりてん}→代理店：21690_dairiten⟧ (agency, a business acting on another's behalf). It plans campaigns and brokers ad placements for client companies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{大手|おおて}→大手：12171_oote⟧{広告|こうこく}{代理店|だいりてん}: major advertising agency
- {広告|こうこく}{代理店|だいりてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{依頼|いらい}する→依頼する：21376_irai⟧: to commission an ad agency

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{広告|こうこく}→広告：02747_koukoku⟧{会社|がいしゃ}: advertising company — nearly synonymous, slightly more general
- PR{会社|がいしゃ}: PR firm — focuses on public relations rather than paid ads
